تستذكري (form X)
# تَسْتَذْكِرِي (tastaḏkirī) /tas.tað.ki.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
# تُسْتَذْكَرِي (tustaḏkarī) /tus.tað.ka.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَذْكَرَ (istaḏkara)
